## Summary

Explain the problem and the user/security impact of this change.

## Change type

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Security hardening
- [ ] Data-integrity change
- [ ] Documentation / maintenance

## Validation

- [ ] `pytest`
- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] Relevant tests added or updated
- [ ] Arabic RTL behavior checked if UI changed
- [ ] Backup/export/import behavior checked if data paths changed

## Security & privacy review

- [ ] No secrets, production databases, backups, customer images, or personal data committed
- [ ] Authorization impact reviewed
- [ ] CSRF/session behavior reviewed where relevant
- [ ] File upload/export risks reviewed where relevant

## Evidence

Add sanitized test output, screenshots, or reproduction details.
